description: This file defines the 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport' class, which implements an endpoint for generating leave entitlement and usage reports within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for report header and filter definitions, data retrieval, validation, and access control, and utilizes various traits for permissions, localization, and leave management.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: Implements an API report endpoint for employee leave entitlement and usage statistics, providing header configuration, filtering, validation, and access control mechanisms.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header configuration with columns for leave type, entitlement days, pending approval days, scheduled days, taken days, and balance days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns filter parameters for the report based on incoming request data.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for report request parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report and if the leave period is defined.
